title: Protect Your Idea Before It’s Too Late 💡
description:
The LA Public Library can connect you with a patent lawyer through free consultation sessions for inventors and creators.

📍 First Saturday of every month
⏰ 1–3 PM (30-min sessions, registration required)
🏛️ Central Library

Can’t make it in person? Virtual appointments are available most days.

Protect your ideas, get expert guidance, and take the next step.
Learn more at LAPL.org ✨
